name: dsh-skill-sidebar
description: DSH plugin (web + Desktop): a 技能 (Skills) page tab in DSH's OFFICIAL right Sidebar (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right) that lists all locally readable skills with short Chinese descriptions. Persists a cache so the list appears instantly on startup, auto-adds newly installed skills, and re-scans all skills every Monday. Runs unchanged in the DSH desktop client (dsh-app:// shell), with a desktop-adapted hover overlay.

scripts.test: node test-client.mjs && node test-host.mjs && node test-desktop.mjs
